name: Is it possible to replace a cracked tile without damaging surrounding tiles or the subfloor?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to replace a cracked tile without damaging surrounding tiles or the subfloor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to replace a cracked tile without damaging surrounding elements, but it requires precision and the correct tools. Professionals typically use specialized grout saws or oscillating tools to carefully remove the grout around the damaged tile. Then, using a hammer and chisel, or a tile removal tool, they meticulously break up and extract the cracked tile in small pieces, avoiding direct contact with adjacent tiles. Proper technique minimizes impact on the subfloor, ensuring a smooth surface for the new tile installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, with precise tools like grout saws and careful removal techniques, professionals can replace a cracked tile without damaging surrounding tiles or the subfloor.
